viewerScopeReview.resolution: The owner explicitly approved publication of the application code and this atlas under CC BY-SA 4.0 on 2026-10-28. Conservative exclusions and upstream component terms remain in effect; no additional personal author permission is asserted.

rules.note: Conservative exclusions prevent uncertain components from entering a private proposed export. Membership is not a finding that every member is an NC derivative.

geometryPolicy.oneFaceNote: 63 single-face meshes exist. The 60 in the official Joints category include authored ligament planes and are retained as real authored surfaces. The other three remain review candidates rather than being called missing nerves.
geometryPolicy.coordinateSystem: Source Blender metres, Z up; convert consistently, preserving bilateral object matrices.

normalization.normalTransform: inverse transpose of common rotation times source evaluated world matrix

classification.method: Pinned official collection/ancestry and effective material metadata, reviewed before export. Arterial/venous classification also requires the official cardiovascular top-level system; a display material alone never classifies a CNS object as a vessel. No object-name keyword inference for arterial, venous or neural classification.

lodPolicy.high: Every evaluated source triangle retained; exact position+normal welding, lossless reordering and Meshopt compression only. No subdivision, smoothing or geometric decimation.
lodPolicy.authoredNormalPolicy: All valid authored normals are preserved. Only exactly zero source corner normals receive area-weighted normals derived from their incident evaluated source triangles; positions and topology are unchanged.

lodPolicy.preview: 25% target, at most 12000 triangles where the 0.5 mm estimated appearance error and locked authored boundaries permit; exceptions explicitly listed.
lodPolicy.limitations: Preview error is a meshoptimizer appearance estimate, not a medical accuracy guarantee. Source curves are evaluated from their authored bevel/extrude settings; no routes or radii are invented. This reviewed corpus is not every anatomical nerve or microvessel.
